headlines.summary: 김정관 산업통상부 장관이 22일 국회 산업통상중소벤처기업위원회에서 '대한민국과 미합중국 간 전략적투자의 운영 및 관리를 위한 특별법'에 따른 대미투자 사전보고를 하고 있다. /연합뉴스 산업통상부가 대미 투자 프로젝트 1호 사업으로 텍사스주 엔시날 가스복합화력발전소 건설 사업을 보고한 것으로 알려졌다.

headlines.title: 서울 아파트거래 22%가 6억 이하 …정책대출 커트라인에 몰렸다
headlines.summary: 1만709건 거래…전년동기比 11% 급등 6억 초과하면 디딤돌대출 등 못 받아 매수세에 가격↑…“저가 아파트 소멸” 올해 서울에서 거래된 아파트 5채 중 1채 이상이 ‘6억원 이하’인 것으로 나타났다. 전셋값 급등에 대출 문턱마저 높아지자, 정책대출을 받을 수 있는 시세 6억원 이하의 집으로 매수세가 몰린 것으로 풀이된다.

headlines.title: 거래 말랐는데 신고가는 속출 …“ 2022년 급락장과는 다르다 ”
headlines.summary: 서울 아파트 거래량 석달새 62.8% 급감 역대 최고가 이어져…서울 외곽 급속 확산 가격하락 앞서 거래량 감소 과거 사례에도 “공급 부족·대출 제한에 시장 영향 제한적” 서울 아파트 매매 거래가 급감한 가운데, 신고가 거래는 곳곳에서 속출하고 있다. 하지만 시장에선 거래량 감소가 급격한 가격 조정으로 이어지긴 어려울 것으로 내다보고 있다.

headlines.title: 강남 넘어 오금동도 공사비 3.3㎡당 1000만원 육박
headlines.summary: ‘천정부지’ 치솟는 서울 재건축 공사비 송파구 오금현대 평당 962만원 제시 목동4·13단지 등 곳곳서 1000만원 공사비 급등에 분양가 1년새 34% 상승 반포·여의도·압구정 등 한강변 핵심 정비사업지를 넘어 서울 곳곳에서 3.3㎡(평)당 1000만원 안팎의 공사비 사례가 나타나고 있다.

headlines.summary: 중동外 수입시 발생 운임차액 지원금 현행 25%서 확대키로 미국·이란 전쟁에 따른 호르무즈 해협 운항 차질로 원유 수급 공급망에 큰 위기를 겪은 정부가 국내 도입 원유의 중동산 비중을 절반 이하로 줄이기로 했다.

headlines.title: 정부, 非중동 원유 수입부과금 환급 확대조치 재시행
headlines.summary: 정부가 중동 정세 불안에 따른 원유 수급 차질에 대응하기 위해 비(非)중동산 원유에 대한 수입부과금 환급 확대 조치를 재시행한다. 정부는 제6차 부담금운용심의위원회를 서면으로 열고 올해 9~12월 한시적으로 다변화 원유 수입부과금 환급 요건을 완화하고 환급 한도도 확대하기로 했다고 24일 밝혔다. 국제유가.

headlines.title: [금융현미경]유가·금리·경기… 추석 전후 韓 환율 향방 최대 변수는
headlines.summary: 유가 및 주요국 통화긴축 따른 달러·엔 등 움직임에 영향 반도체發 수출 호조 지속…환율 상승 제어 요인으로 원·달러 환율이 재차 1350원 선으로 내려앉았다. 유가 흐름이 환율 향방의 핵심 변수로 자리 잡은 상황에서 미·이란 간 긴장 완화 기대감, 사우디아라비아의 원유 수출 확대 기대감 등이 작용하며 유가가 하락한 영향이다.

headlines.title: 인구감소 · 주택거래 둔화 … 8월 이동자 수 53년 만에 최소
headlines.summary: ▲ 서울 아파트 인구 감소 흐름에 주택 거래까지 둔화하면서 8월 국내 이동자 수가 같은 달 기준으로 53년 만에 가장 적었습니다. 국가데이터처가 오늘(23일) 발표한 '8월 국내인구이동 통계'를 보면 지난달 국내 이동자 수는 47만1천명으로 1년 전보다 4.5%(2만2천명) 감소했습니다.

key_headlines.title: OECD Raises Korea's 2026 Growth Forecast to 3.7% - Largest Increase Among G20
key_headlines.summary: The OECD significantly raised Korea's economic growth forecast from 2.6% to 3.7%, marking the largest upward revision among G20 nations. The upgrade is driven by strong semiconductor exports and expected consumer recovery.

key_headlines.title: Korean Won Stabilizes at 1,350 Level as Oil Prices Fall and Semiconductor Exports Remain Strong
key_headlines.summary: The Korean won-dollar exchange rate has declined to the 1,350 level due to falling oil prices and continued strong semiconductor exports. Oil price movements have become the key variable determining exchange rate direction around the Chuseok holiday period.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Sales Show 22% Below 600 Million Won Due to Policy Loan Thresholds
key_headlines.summary: Over one-fifth of apartment transactions in Seoul are for properties priced at 600 million won or below, as buyers concentrate on units eligible for government-backed loans. This concentration is driving up prices of lower-priced apartments while higher-priced units face weaker demand.

key_headlines.title: Korea-US Nuclear Cooperation: Plan to Develop 8 Reactors Including Korean APR1400 Model
key_headlines.summary: South Korea and the US are considering joint development of 8 nuclear reactors - 6 Westinghouse AP1000 units and 2 Korean APR1400 models. This marks a significant opportunity for Korean nuclear technology to enter the US market as a major overseas investment project.

key_headlines.title: Customs Service Removes Cap on Whistleblower Reward Amounts to Combat Smuggling
key_headlines.summary: The Korea Customs Service has eliminated the ceiling on whistleblower rewards and introduced a progressive payment system offering up to 3 times the reward for insider reports. The reform aims to maximize the effectiveness of the reporting system as illegal activities become more sophisticated.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's economic outlook has brightened significantly with multiple international institutions upgrading growth forecasts, with OECD leading at 3.7% for 2026. Strong semiconductor exports and anticipated consumer recovery are primary drivers of optimism. The won-dollar exchange rate has stabilized around 1,350, supported by declining oil prices and robust chip sector performance. Seoul's real estate market shows structural shifts as policy loan thresholds redirect buyer demand toward lower-priced properties. Trade and investment corridors are expanding with Korea-US nuclear cooperation plans and various government export support initiatives.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea has maintained its accommodative stance while international rate pressures mount, with the Fed continuing tightening and signaling further increases ahead. Multiple international organizations including OECD, ADB, Bank of Korea, and KDI have upwardly revised Korea's growth forecasts, reflecting semiconductor-led export strength and anticipated domestic demand recovery. The government is implementing targeted support programs including agricultural product export vouchers and industrial region development initiatives. High oil prices remain a concern for inflation, with international bodies warning of consumer price pressures in the 3% range. Credit card companies are building cash reserves, with Samsung Card and Shinhan Card accumulating trillions in provisions amid economic uncertainty.
sections.Financial Markets: US Treasury yields surged significantly, creating mixed conditions in both US and Korean financial markets with concerns about sustained high interest rates. Higher long-term US rates are expected to increase domestic interest rates, weaken the won, and trigger foreign capital outflows from Korean equities. The New York stock market showed mixed performance amid rising oil prices and Treasury yields, with bond markets becoming critical focus points for investors. Korean semiconductor stocks have attracted attention due to potential earnings upside and attractive valuations relative to fundamentals. The KOSPI maintains historically low valuation multiples at 5.49x forward PER, suggesting potential for recovery once sentiment improves.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea is pursuing ambitious nuclear energy expansion through both domestic and international projects, with plans for 8 reactors in the US and significant domestic capacity additions to support AI data center demand. Semiconductor industry continues strong performance, serving as primary engine for export growth and equipment investment expansion. Solid-state battery development faces delays, with industry experts suggesting mass production within 5 years remains challenging despite technological progress. Regional governments are providing customized support to key industrial clusters, particularly petrochemicals and steel sectors, to address corporate financial challenges. HVAC, security, and power equipment sectors are expanding service offerings to AI data centers, which are proliferating rapidly due to rising power demand from semiconductor and AI investments.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices for units under 600 million won are experiencing strong demand concentration due to government-backed loan eligibility thresholds, while higher-priced properties face weaker demand. Older apartments over 20 years are outperforming new construction in price appreciation, with reconstruction projects showing particular strength. Seoul jeonse (long-term lease) prices hit new all-time highs at 636.62 million won, breaking the previous record from January 2022, with 84 consecutive weeks of increases. Apartment subscription lottery disqualifications have reached 53,867 cases over six years, with the most common reason being errors in calculating non-homeowner duration. Major relocation waves are anticipated from 2028 onward due to redevelopment and reconstruction projects, with potential to create supply-demand imbalances in the rental market.
sections.International Economy: China and the US reached new trade agreement framework during their summit, with President Trump emphasizing wartime alliance history in remarks that raised Japanese concerns about anti-Japan sentiment. The EU is pressuring the UK to align with European trade policy by raising tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles to avoid protectionist barriers. International trade dynamics are shifting with increasing focus on semiconductor technology, AI investment, and electric vehicle competitiveness among major economies. The Trump-Xi summit highlighted technology and trade as central economic policy concerns, with implications for global supply chains and investment flows. Currency and financial market movements remain volatile amid geopolitical tensions and divergent monetary policy stances across major economies.
sections.AI & Economy: The US is embarking on unprecedented AI infrastructure investment estimated at 10.3 trillion dollars through 2032, representing 3.63% of GDP annually - exceeding historical investment in railroads and highways. AI data center construction is spurring demand for supporting technologies including advanced HVAC systems, security solutions, and specialized power equipment, creating new business opportunities for industrial support sectors. Qualcomm unveiled latest mobile chipsets for agentic AI, intensifying competition with Apple, Samsung Electronics, and MediaTek in mobile processor development. The Korean government is evaluating significant new nuclear capacity requirements of 18.4 gigawatts by 2035 to support AI data center and semiconductor cluster electricity needs. Employment policies are being debated to address AI-induced job displacement while encouraging firms to invest in workforce expansion rather than pure automation.
sections.Others: Hyundai Motor is positioned to potentially surpass Ford for third place in the US vehicle market, citing advantages in manufacturing costs and supply chain efficiency from Korean operations rather than US-based production. US state dinner guest lists prominently feature major technology and semiconductor executives including Jensen Huang, Lisa Su, and Tim Cook, while notably excluding Chinese business leaders. Global AI industry leaders are promoting speed moderation approaches prioritizing human safety, though these proposals face skepticism regarding practical implementation. The automotive sector faces intensifying competition on tariffs, exchange rates, and labor costs, with Korean manufacturers gaining relative advantages through efficiency improvements and favorable production economics.
